title: Sentinel ITAD | Secure IT Asset Disposal and Logistics in Meridian & Boise
description: Sentinel ITAD helps Treasure Valley businesses clear retired servers, workstations, networking gear, and data-bearing media with secure local pickup, chain-of-custody intake, value recovery, and responsible downstream recycling.

hero.eyebrow: Meridian, Idaho · Serving the Treasure Valley
hero.title: Secure IT asset disposal and logistics for teams that cannot afford loose ends.
hero.body: Sentinel helps MSPs, offices, and compliance-conscious businesses clear retired servers, workstations, networking gear, and storage media with local pickup, documented intake, value recovery, and responsible downstream recycling.
hero.imageAlt: Secure IT asset recovery console beside enterprise server equipment

warning.body: We document what actually happened: pickup, intake, serial/media handling, sanitization or downstream routing, and exceptions. Trust signals beat theater.

cards.title: IT asset pickup
cards.body: Local removal for retired servers, workstations, desktops, networking gear, storage arrays, cables, rails, and related business hardware.

cards.title: MSP feeder bins
cards.body: For recurring MSP clutter: a controlled collection point for client refresh leftovers, with scheduled pickup when the bin fills.

cards.title: Data-bearing media handling
cards.body: Drives and removable storage are separated, logged where required, and routed for wipe, destruction, return, or downstream partner processing.

cards.title: Value recovery
cards.body: Servers, RAM, CPUs, NICs, SSDs, monitors, and workstations are tested for reuse or resale when practical instead of being blindly scrapped.

trustItems.title: Local accountability
trustItems.body: Based in Meridian, operated by Growth Web Development LLC DBA Sentinel IT Asset Disposal and Logistics.

trustItems.title: Documented custody
trustItems.body: Pickup records, ticket IDs, serial/media notes, and disposition records where the job requires them.

trustItems.title: Honest compliance posture
trustItems.body: Insured; certificates and additional insured documentation are available for approved jobs. No unsupported claims of R2v3/NAID certification.

trustItems.title: Security-first language
trustItems.body: The core offer is liability reduction and responsible disposition, not junk hauling.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: You tell us what you have: counts, asset classes, media sensitivity, stairs/loading constraints, and timing.

steps.title: Pickup
steps.body: We schedule local pickup or bin placement and record the custody handoff for sensitive jobs.

steps.title: Intake
steps.body: Assets are sorted into reuse, resale, part-out, internal-use, data-media, and downstream recycling paths.

steps.title: Disposition
steps.body: You receive the appropriate record: pickup receipt, asset/media log, sanitization/destruction evidence, or downstream partner documentation.

primaryCta.title: Tell us what needs to disappear responsibly.
primaryCta.body: Include rough counts, whether storage media is involved, and your pickup location.
